findings.issue: P-01 (2.7.3: a cone or line originates at the effect's source and does not affect the combatant it originates from). Panel A text "A Cone or Line does not affect the combatant it originates from" and the caption clause match the patched sentence. Cone count re-derived and re-measured in a 250 ppi render: 3" cone with apex at the origin-square centre and far edge 3" wide at 3" distance; centres satisfy |dy|<=dx/2 at dx=1 (1 square), dx=2 (3 squares, ties outward) and dx=3 (3 squares) = 7 squares beyond the origin square, none hatched in the origin square. The count 7 is consistent with P-01 (it counts squares other than the origin square and does not depend on whether the origin square is counted).

findings.issue: Wording slightly exceeds P-01. Panel C says "The origin square (the source) is not affected" and the caption says a cone "affects 7 squares and not its origin square, because a cone or line does not affect the combatant it originates from". P-01 excludes the originating COMBATANT, not the origin SQUARE as a square: the Line row of the Affected Squares table explicitly includes the origin square, the Cone row is silent, and a 2x2/3x3 source's other footprint squares can lie inside the cone. Any marker or hazard sharing the origin square is not addressed by P-01. The 7-square count is unaffected; only the "origin square is not affected" inference is not literally in the patched text. Panel A omits the rule's "Unless a rule says otherwise" qualifier (minor).

findings.fix: Either draw G2 in barrow water or log the ambiguity; move labels clear of the Sanctum.

findings.issue: Reed screens are drawn with the Difficult pattern; the source gives no terrain type.
